review_text: Always a favorite! Dunkin' Donuts in Davao got a huge upgrade through its first drive-thru branch in Bago Aplaya. You can enjoy your Dunkin' faves with less hassle. My go-to orders have always been Boston Kreme and a cup of brewed coffee.
My best dunkin donut branch in the Philippines! Wide space for parking, minimalistic design, drive thru option, staff is accommodating too.
